description: A local system activity recorder and visual execution replay tool for Linux commands.
name: ghostglass

scripts.build: tsc && npm run build:web && npm run build:export-assets && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('test/fixtures', 'dist/test/fixtures', { recursive: true })"
scripts.build:web: npm run vendor:cause-web && npm run vendor:query-web && tsc -p web && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('web/public', 'web/dist', { recursive: true })"
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js run -- node test/fixtures/demo.cjs && node dist/src/cli.js open latest
scripts.typecheck: npm run vendor:cause-web && npm run vendor:query-web && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit
scripts.build:export-assets: npm run vendor:cause-web && npm run vendor:query-web && esbuild web/src/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/export-assets/viewer.js && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('web/dist/styles.css', 'dist/export-assets/styles.css')"
